ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60% high-intensity light-yellowish pixels to 40% low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity dark V-shaped region at the peduncle junction, bifurcating into two large high-intensity cream/white zones covering the medial lobe areas. These zones are bordered by thick, irregular low-intensity dark perimeters along the trailing and leading edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees and a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; prominent macro-indentation (notch) located on the distal third of the right lobe's trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge transitioning into sharply upward-tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous low-intensity dark linear streaks and unaligned rake marks intersecting the high-intensity pigmented zones, most notably a series of diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable semi-circular tissue loss/indentation on the right lobe trailing edge; dense calcified barnacle clusters on distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct small circular dark pigment spots located in the lower-inner quadrant of the right lobe's high-intensity zone.
